caller_boundary.tracked_python_sources: all Git-tracked *.py files at the base commit
caller_boundary.purpose: derive every ORION-to-PyZX import, attribute access, wrapper, callback, registration path, and dynamically named target that can reach a graph mutation

resolution_algorithm: Create a fresh bare clone with object replacement, grafts, and alternates disabled.
Fetch all advertised branch and tag refs from the declared remote; record the remote-ref advertisement and fetch stderr/stdout hashes.
Enumerate commits reachable from the fetched refs with `git rev-list --all`, retain object names beginning exactly with `dade7d46`, and require one match.
Require the unique object name to contain exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters and `git cat-file -t` to return `commit`.
Resolve and record the commit tree, parent list, commit object bytes hash, and signed-tag path if any; a tag is not substituted for the commit.
Check out the tree into an empty directory with submodules disabled unless the pinned tree itself declares a submodule required by the Python package.
Write `SOURCE_RESOLUTION_RECEIPT.json` before importing, installing, executing, or semantically scanning the source.

included: every Git-tracked regular file below the pinned `pyzx/` package directory
every Git-tracked Python packaging file that can alter package import or plugin registration
every Git-tracked resource loaded by an included Python module at runtime
the pinned commit object and tree listing
the ORION caller-boundary Python sources at the declared base commit
excluded: files obtained from a floating package index release
local site customizations outside the frozen environment
test-only, documentation-only, or example-only code unless reachable from a production entry root
byte_corpus.path_order: raw UTF-8 byte order after POSIX path normalization
byte_corpus.symlink_policy: record link target bytes; do not follow outside the pinned tree
byte_corpus.submodule_policy: fail closed until every required submodule is separately commit-pinned and hashed

root_union: all PyZX call targets reachable from the frozen ORION caller boundary
all runtime registries, decorators, plugin tables, dispatch dictionaries, and callback lists reachable from those targets
all public PyZX rewrite or simplification entry points transitively invoked by the ORION call targets
all magic-method or protocol callbacks that can apply or return a graph mutation on those paths
closure_edges: function values passed as arguments or returned
callbacks passed into traversal or simplification drivers
production_reachability.dead_code_rule: A callable is outside the production semantic boundary only after the closure receipt proves it unreachable from the root union under the frozen environment and admissible inputs.
